mapper.sql: u.status = 1 AND (u.nick_name LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR u.person_introduction LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_info u WHERE

SELECT CAST(u.user_id AS CHAR) AS userId, u.nick_name AS nickName, u.avatar, u.person_introduction AS personIntroduction, u.follower_count AS followerCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_info a WHERE a.user_id = u.user_id AND a.status = 1) AS articleCount, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_focus f WHERE f.user_id = #{viewerId} AND f.focus_user_id = u.user_id) AS isFollowing FROM user_info u WHERE ORDER BY CASE WHEN u.nick_name = #{keyword} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, u.user_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT u.user_id as userId, u.nick_name as nickName, u.avatar, u.person_introduction as personIntroduction, u.article_count as articleCount, u.follower_count as followerCount, u.following_count as followingCount, uf.focus_time as focusTime, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_focus WHERE user_id = #{currentUserId} AND focus_user_id = u.user_id ) > 0 as isFollowing FROM user_focus uf LEFT JOIN user_info u ON uf.user_id = u.user_id WHERE uf.focus_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uf.focus_time DESC

select u.user_id,u.nick_name,u.avatar,u.person_introduction,u.article_count,u.follower_count,u.following_count,uf.focus_time from user_focus uf left join user_info u on u.user_id = uf.focus_user_id where uf.user_id = #{userId} order by uf.focus_time desc
mapper.update: UPDATE user_info SET password=#{encoded} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND password=#{expected}
